title: Juniper and the Locker
author: Marguerite Eastwick
blurb: Juniper Hartwell, the eldest sibling raising the younger ones while mom works nights, is fine. Everything is fine. Obviously.. Then the teacher pairs nemesis with nemesis for a semester-long project — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must expose what the school board buried before graduation.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
